description: Fetch course calendar events — exams, midterms, labs, recitations, review sessions, schedule changes, and deadlines instructors typed straight onto the calendar — across all your courses or one course, in a time window (default: the next 7 days). Use this when the user asks when an exam is, what's on their calendar, or what's happening this week.

courseId.description: Course ID to get calendar events for. If omitted, returns events across all enrolled courses.

from.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-01-15T00:00:00Z). Defaults to now.

includeGenerated.description: Include the events Brightspace generates from assignment, quiz, and discussion due dates (marked with generatedFrom). Off by default because get_upcoming_due_dates and get_assignments already report those.

to.description: End of the window, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-01-22T00:00:00Z). Defaults to 7 days after from.

name: get_calendar_events
title: Get Calendar Events
